category.description: An Event's main category first, one of the platform's fifteen event codes (music, theatre-dance, film, exhibition-museum, festival-fair, sport, outdoor-nature, education-talk, children-family, hobby-workshop, food-market, history-heritage, faith-tradition, health-wellness, community-civic), then the Smart Data Models category it falls under where one fits, read from the first words of the Catalan name and absent when no rule matches. A PointOfInterest's family in the city's facility register first (culture-leisure, sports, education, social-services, public-administration, markets-shopping, information-centres, religious-services, environment, animals-plants, cemeteries, media, utility-companies, restaurants), then the register's own kind in Catalan (Biblioteques, Poliesportius). An OnStreetParking's kind of regulated parking, from the section type (AZL blue zone, VM green zone, VR residents, DUM loading, BUS coaches).
